questions.prompt: Which approach best applies battery and network efficiency?
options: Measure end-to-end work and coalesce deferrable CPU/network activity while preserving durable user intent.
questions.answer: Measure end-to-end work and coalesce deferrable CPU/network activity while preserving durable user intent.
questions.explanation: This answer preserves the underlying platform or delivery contract while requiring representative evidence, explicit failure behaviour, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: Fewer bytes always means lower battery use regardless of request count and timing.
questions.explanation: Retrying every failed request immediately can keep CPU and radio active, amplify a service outage and drain battery without improving success.

questions.prompt: Why can many tiny cellular requests cost more than one batch?
questions.answer: Each request can incur scheduling, connection and radio high-power tail overhead.
questions.explanation: The response identifies the mechanism that makes the decision reliable instead of relying on a convenient proxy.
